UPDATE invoices
        SET target_date = $2,
            branch_id = $3,
            discount = $4::float8,
            discount_unit = $5,
            customer_id = $6,
            total_price = $7::float8,
            gift_card_redeemed = $8::float8,
            is_urgent = $9,
            urgent_charge = $10::float8,
            collection_method = $11
        WHERE id = $1
